target_claim: External fixed-frame replication of the DIRECT versus CP ordering at t=.5 and t=1; no learned selector, no new testing principle, no source-population guarantee.

dataset.name: VLCS (G2DM-distributed image frame)
dataset.class_split_rule: First five lexicographic SHA256 hashes of protocol_id|class_split|comma_joined_known among sorted 3-of-5 numeric label IDs; no semantic relabeling.
dataset.identity: SHA256 of uint32-big-endian width,height followed by decoded EXIF-transposed RGB bytes
dataset.duplicate_rule: Collapse identical RGB content within a domain and class; conflicting class labels INVALID; same content across domains kept but assigned the same role
dataset.role_rule: H=int(SHA256(protocol_id|role|image_identity)); training if 5*H<3*2**256; proposal if 5*H<4*2**256; audit otherwise
dataset.overlap_with_old_audit_sources: Exact RGB identity check required before training; any detected overlap HOLD, no silent deletion
dataset.domain_support_required: All class/domain combinations present; nonempty known-class training per domain and nonempty proposal/audit per domain
dataset.source_roles: Use archive full and test folders, collapse identical RGB within domain/class; train/crossval are duplicate partition views and are retained in source audit only. Verify 10729 source entries before deduplication. New global roles ignore the supplied train/test partition.
dataset.provenance_gate: All images decode; five label IDs in four domains; class-conflicting identity INVALID; same identity global role; exact overlap with PACS and required prior image sources checked before training. State the G2DM distribution; do not claim byte/pixel equality with DomainBed or original constituent sources.

training.head: Fresh 3-class Linear head; numeric known label order ascending
training.loss: CrossEntropyLoss(mean), no dummy head, no label smoothing, no class weighting
training.aggregation: known training sample-count weighted float64 mean of floating parameters and buffers, cast to original dtype; integer buffers from largest-client model, lexical domain tie break
training.precision: FP32, no AMP, no TF32, no compile; deterministic algorithms required
training.train_transform: EXIF transpose/RGB; RandomResizedCrop(224,scale=(.08,1),ratio=(.75,4/3),bilinear,antialias=True); HorizontalFlip(.5); ToTensor; ImageNet mean/std
training.inference_transform: EXIF transpose/RGB; Resize(shorter=256,bilinear,antialias=True); CenterCrop(224); ToTensor; ImageNet mean/std
training.rng: seed(label,parts)=big-endian integer of first 8 SHA256 bytes of protocol_id|label|json.dumps(parts,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=True). Torch seed modulo 2**63, NumPy PCG64 full uint64. model_init parts=[arch,split,seed]; local_training parts=[arch,split,seed,round,domain]; num_workers=0
training.run_order: split ascending, seed ascending, architecture order resnet18 then convnext_tiny

candidate_family.scores: softmax-known max; logsumexp-known at T=1 (negative energy, higher accepts); top1-top2 known probability
candidate_family.proposal: pool all proposal domains unweighted by record; maximize accepted count subject to K/A<=gamma/5, A>=1; exact rational risk comparisons; tie smaller threshold
candidate_family.infeasible: reject-all slot retained in M=12; never replace
candidate_family.certified_selection: maximum common positive acceptance LCB; tie smaller gamma, lexical score alias, candidate index

audit.budget_unit: with-replacement audit draws, not unique acquired labels
audit.draws: nested fixed-size prefixes; NumPy PCG64 uniform integer draws; no adaptive stopping
audit.draw_seed: Use frozen seed function with label=audit_draw and parts=[split,domain,replicate]; choose indices from source-identity-sorted domain audit list
audit.coupling: same (split,domain,replicate) stream across architectures, training seeds, all methods, both t and all budgets; independent replicate streams
audit.certifier_information: proposal eligibility plus n,A,K count tensors; no full-frame labels, error rates, future outcomes or full acceptance masks
audit.risk_engines: Frozen seven constructions in manuscript Section 4.4 and Supplement S19; unchanged stakes and family size.
audit.guarantee_scope: Per fixed model, budget, t and prespecified procedure; not simultaneous over all reported experiment rows
audit.full_frame_truth: Only post-decision evaluator may compute exact empirical risks and acceptance from full audit frame

procedures.diagnostic_role: Both derived rules are descriptive controls; no V1 performance gate is applied to VLCS.

analysis.primary_metric: ECA=common acceptance lower bound of selected certified candidate; refusal=0
analysis.per_arch_estimand: Separately by protection task: average ECA difference across all 15 fixed models per architecture; signs and gate as hypotheses.
analysis.statistical_unit: one complete audit-replicate block across all 30 models and all conditions; 100 independent RNG blocks conditional on fixed inputs
analysis.CI: 20000 paired whole-audit-block percentile resamples; shared indices; linear quantiles .00625 and .99375 for four primary contrasts.
analysis.CI_scope: Approximate simultaneous conditional Monte Carlo uncertainty; not source-population, architecture-population, or finite-sample coverage guarantee
analysis.support: report all per-model deltas, per-split seed means, win/tie/loss and each t separately; no selective model exclusion
secondary: ECA by each budget and t
analysis.missing: retain full matrix; incomplete or failed run not treated as refusal or imputed zero

preexecution_amendments: Before any VLCS prediction/training: remove inherited PACS 16-comparison analysis text that conflicted with the explicitly stated four-contrast V2 gate. No scientific threshold, hypothesis, class split, or seed changed.

hypotheses.H05: DIRECT_BETTING_H minus CP_IUT_H positive at t=.5, separately for each architecture
hypotheses.H1: CP_IUT_H minus DIRECT_BETTING_H positive at t=1, separately for each architecture
hypotheses.gate: CONFIRM if every signed architecture/task contrast is >=.01 and every Bonferroni-adjusted paired audit-block bootstrap lower bound is >0. KILL if any upper bound <=0; otherwise HOLD. INVALID/INCOMPLETE precede performance. Conditional fixed-model Monte Carlo intervals only. Existing PACS gate untouched.
hypotheses.bootstrap: 20000 paired whole-audit-block resamples shared over all 30 models and both tasks; PCG64 seed 2026092301; equal model weights. Quantiles .00625/.99375 for 4 contrasts. Separate per-seed and per-split summaries, no new-model confidence claim.

TV_control_scope: Not an empirical primary comparator on this geometry: center uniform has eta=3t/4. At t=.5 or1, eta>alpha=.2; the sufficient condition D_w+eta<=0 is impossible even if every accepted prediction is correct and acceptance=1. Report analytically, not as a new measured win.

run_constraints.resource_accounting: persist cumulative GPU-section wall time at every round; fail closed at cap or validation failure; no stop based on favorable performance

primary_analysis: hypotheses is the sole V2 scientific gate; V1 and GEOMETRY_DIRECT_CP are descriptive controls alongside all seven fixed procedures.
amendment_reason: Before any VLCS prediction/training: remove inherited PACS 16-comparison analysis text that conflicted with the explicitly stated four-contrast V2 gate. No scientific threshold, hypothesis, class split, or seed changed.
